object.name: Kairo, Ägyptisches Museum, TR 25/3/52/1_(15+19)
object.date: Second Intermediate Period, Dynasty 15 – Second Intermediate Period, Dynasty 17

source.attribution: Facsimile by Aurore Motte; AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 51167

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 51167; AKU grapheme A0010 (AKU GR 1). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: A1 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 33, 33B. Occurrence: find place Scheich Abd el-Qurna; writing direction "Kolumnen, linksläufig prograd"; ink colour "schwarz"; sign size 8 x 13.7 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Zweite Zwischenzeit, 15. Dynastie – Zweite Zwischenzeit, 17. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Digitalisat (Kooperationspartner), by Aurore Motte. Rendered from the source SVG facsimile to PNG at 20 px/mm (long edge clamped to 160-600 px) on a white background with a white margin.
